faq.question: What is Amazon DSP and when should sellers use it?
faq.answer: Amazon DSP buys display and video inventory for awareness and retargeting on and off Amazon. It fits brands with an established Sponsored Ads foundation, Brand Registry access where required, and goals beyond last-click conversion alone.

faq.question: Do I need Brand Registry for DSP?
faq.answer: Brand Registry is typically required for self-service DSP access and many brand advertising features. We confirm eligibility during the free audit.

faq.question: How does DSP relate to Sponsored Ads?
faq.answer: DSP supports upper-funnel reach and retargeting. Sponsored Ads capture high-intent search and product detail page demand. We plan both so awareness spend supports Amazon conversion.

faq.question: What budget makes sense for DSP?
faq.answer: Budget depends on category competition, creative readiness, and funnel goals. We recommend a starting range during the free audit rather than publishing a one-size minimum.

faq.question: How do you measure DSP success?
faq.answer: We track delivery quality, engagement, new-to-brand indicators where available, and downstream Amazon sales impact alongside Sponsored Ads performance.

faq.question: Can you manage creative for DSP campaigns?
faq.answer: Yes. We coordinate creative requirements and can align with our visual and video teams so assets match Amazon shopping behavior.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do you support?
faq.answer: We support advertising programs across official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. DSP availability and inventory differ by market; scope is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a funnel-fit review, eligibility check, then a DSP plan aligned to Sponsored Ads.
